title: wwp-bscw-womens-heavyweight
label: Talia Wichzini

won.source: The federation's own founding FAQ describes the belt as a gift to Talia from BSCW's own authority figure, following her own run as a prior champion under BSCW's banner; no in-ring event is described.

how: Received the belt from BSCW's own authority figure as WWP launched, not the result of an in-ring match.
